theme: An open day in St. Pete, girls in the house.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan, so the day is genuinely yours before tomorrow's house move and the Brunswick call. A good window to get your bio out and clear the Croatia bookings that keep sliding.

needsAttention.detail: Lauren Nadig locked a 3:30 PM Teams call for Thursday. Worth deciding going in what you want a Brunswick relationship to open up on the public-affairs and board side.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your own reminder from yesterday is still sitting unread — the board bio and email address you meant to get over to them.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The changeover to the St. Pete Ranch house is tomorrow, and the bin was meant to be packed first so the first migration doubles as the test run.
